applies: Title 18-C (Maine Uniform Probate Code), effective 2019-09-01 — see transition_18a.

considerations.title: Emergency guardian
considerations.note: Must show likelihood of substantial harm without immediate appointment.

considerations.title: Emergency conservator
considerations.note: Property-risk counterpart for an emergency conservator.

considerations.title: Emergency guardian
considerations.note: Emergency powers are limited to those needed to prevent the harm.

considerations.title: Emergency guardian

transition_18a: 18-C Article 5 (Maine Uniform Guardianship, Conservatorship and Protective Proceedings Act) governs proceedings pending on or commenced after 2019-09-01. Orders entered under former Title 18-A may rest on different standards; the modern least-restrictive / supported-decision-making framework applies going forward. See _index/18a-key-diffs.json.

caselaw.name: Adult Guardianship and Conservatorship of T.
caselaw.holding: Appointing DHHS as an adult's full guardian and conservator under 18-C M.R.S. §§ 5-301 and 5-401(2): the guardianship statutes create a single 'unified proceeding,' so a court may consider evidence admitted at an earlier emergency hearing when it rules after the final hearing.
